disclaimer: leakage-audited under the recorded criteria; NOT contamination-proof. Hard negatives are real near-misses re-read from the same pinned sources, not invented contrasts. No expressive source text is redistributed: every member stores spans and hashes.
model_facing_note: tasks.jsonl is the model-facing layer and carries no expected label; the admitted/rejected disposition lives in this report and in reports/sibling_review.json, which are separate clearly-named files

near_duplicate_leakage_audit.note: near-duplicate wording is reported, not removed: a sibling family that contrasts the same API necessarily repeats its own explanation. This layer is leakage-audited under the recorded criteria; it is not contamination-proof

project_holdout_audit.note: a vulnerable-side audited repository seen in two splits would let a model meet the same finding twice; none is. Reference-side repositories are shared library code and do straddle splits by construction -- that residual exposure is reported here rather than claimed away

rights.authority: NOTICE.md: much of this corpus is source-available-but-not-redistributable or ships no licence at all; this layer therefore stores spans and hashes of the pinned bytes rather than the bytes

splits.rule: whole vulnerable-side audited repositories are assigned to one split each, so no audited project's finding is seen twice; reference-side repositories are shared library code by construction and their straddle is measured in the hold-out audit instead of claimed away

target: expand the API-sibling task family from 71 toward 300+

yield.shortfall_explained: the pool holds 229 real cross-repository sibling call sites; 0 could not be re-read from the pinned bytes and 8 failed the contrast under the independent reader, so 221 tasks are admitted. The binding limit is the number of confirmed findings whose cited code actually contains a call to a shared upstream API, not a processing step.
